question: What alternative outcomes can result from performing this observance?
premises: The observance can produce an effect.
One possible effect is destruction of all sins.
Another possible effect is binding accomplishment.
inference: The observance may either destroy all sins or produce a binding form of accomplishment.
uncertainties: The exact sense of siddhibandhakṛt depends on doctrinal context.
plain_english: It may bring about the destruction of all sins, or else produce a binding accomplishment.
